item.description:
Koegaki 1.5.1

  • Fixed: the microphone could stop answering after an audio device change, such as AirPods disconnecting, and every press then sat on Preparing speech engine until Koegaki was quit. Each microphone rebuild now has a time limit. If one misses it, Koegaki reports that the microphone is not responding, tries once more on the next press, and restarts itself if that attempt hangs too.
  • While a dictation waits on the microphone, the on-screen pill now names the microphone instead of the speech engine.
  • A device merely appearing or disappearing no longer rebuilds the microphone while your input device is unchanged.
